item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Health care price transparency bill gains bipartisan support in Congress
item.description: A bipartisan bill could require hospitals to post prices and save families $1,000 a month. Here's what to know.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: Airline fees
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 Reporter Susan El Khoury advises comparing the total trip cost, including baggage and seat selection fees, before booking so you know which ticket is actually the best value.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fauci set for contentious Senate hearing on COVID-19 pandemic origins
item.description: Anthony Fauci returns to Congress as a Senate committee led by Rand Paul investigates the origins of the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for July 29
item.description: Tampa man found guilty of murder after killing man during encounter. Plus, educators speak out about potential health insurance hikes.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mega Millions ticket sold in Florida wins $800 million jackpot: Lottery officials
item.description: A single Mega Millions jackpot-winning ticket sold in Florida matched all six numbers in Tuesday nights drawing, according to the lottery company.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Animal cruelty trial: SPCA Tampa Bay faces judge in viral Waddles the pig case
item.description: A Pinellas County judge will decide Wednesday whether a civil animal cruelty citation against SPCA Tampa Bay stands after a viral pig suffered severe sunburns under shelter care.
